description:
Spacious Double Room with Private Shower Room, WC & Kitchen Section – BS3

Double Room | Private Shower Room & WC | Garden Access | Bills Included | Available NOW*

Looking for a spacious room that offers a little more privacy and independence? This well-presented double room at West Street, Bedminster, Bristol, BS3 3NS comes complete with its own kitchen, private shower room with WC, making it an excellent choice for working professionals seeking comfortable and convenient living.

Available NOW, this room combines the convenience of shared accommodation with the comfort of having your own private facilities.

Step inside and you'll find:

A bright and spacious double bedroom with plenty of room to relax and unwind
Private shower room & WC
Private kitchen section, perfect for preparing light meals and enjoying added independence
Access to a shared outdoor garden/patio area
Neutral décor throughout, ready for you to make the space your own
Fantastic BS3 location close to local shops, cafés, pubs, restaurants and excellent transport links

Situated on West Street, you'll be perfectly positioned to enjoy everything Bedminster has to offer, with North Street, Wapping Wharf and Bristol City Centre all within easy reach.

All bills are included within the rent, with the exception of electricity, which is payable by the tenant.

EPC Rating: D
Security Deposit: £980.77

A fantastic opportunity to secure a spacious room with private facilities in one of Bristol's most desirable locations.

Electricity payable by the tenant. All other bills included.
